metadata.description: Phase 3 Structural Analysis: AlphaFold pLDDT, SLiM exposure estimates, competitive accessibility

methods.plddt: AlphaFold2 predicted LDDT from EBI database
methods.exposure: Composite of Emini accessibility, IUPred3 disorder, pLDDT confidence, and disorder propensity

methods.note: Full MD (CALVADOS 2) and docking (FlexPepDock) require compute clusters
